description: The CRM pipeline for the key account Horizon Technologies Ltd is disorganized and overdue for cleanup. Log into Odoo (admin@example.com / admin, database: odoo_demo) and take the following actions: (1) Navigate to the CRM module and find all opportunities associated with Horizon Technologies Ltd. For any opportunity that has been sitting in an early pipeline stage (New or Qualified) for more than 30 days with no recent activity, mark it as Lost with the reason 'No Response / Stale Opportunity'. (2) For the most recently active opportunity at this account, advance its stage to 'Proposition', set the expected revenue to 65000, and schedule a Phone Call activity titled 'Follow-up call - Horizon Technologies' due 7 days from today. (3) Add an internal note (chatter message) to that active opportunity with the text 'Pipeline cleanup completed. Stale opportunities archived. Follow-up call scheduled.'
